title: Deeper/broader source-visible ACIS implementation and version-specific consumer review
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Reconcile mutable ACadRust source claims with its published crate documentation and test shape
Refresh open-source ACIS parser versus B-rep kernel and mesh-projection boundaries
Screen a downstream DWG/DXF consumer with a version-specific 3DSOLID loss report and audit parser lineage
Clarify DXF SOLID versus modeler 3DSOLID terminology and optional comparator admission

method.kind: Primary-source review of repository source, API documentation, project README/route notes, and Autodesk DXF references
method.limitations: Mutable repository main and published docs.rs versions were not source-bound; no peer was run and no parser lineage audit was performed beyond the public acad-ts provenance statement. Maintainer feature matrices and app-reported loss establish route claims only. No independent B-rep/kernel or native CAD result was collected.

sources.revision: Mutable main Cargo.toml reported 0.6.5; docs.rs latest page reviewed reported 0.5.5; no immutable commit/artifact pair bound
sources.observed: The project advertises DWG/DXF matrices and SAT/SAB typed topology/primitive building. The public round-trip test source includes generated same-implementation write/read cases and synthetic/fake SAB controls. This supports source-visible implementation and self-consistency only, not independent parser, kernel, semantic-solid, or native acceptance claims.

The documentation explicitly excludes an ACIS kernel and arbitrary ACIS load/re-export, says unsupported entities become NONE_ENTITY with data loss, and documents mesh extraction of flat polygonal faces with curved faces lost.

sources.revision: Mutable master/main documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; exact application/package commit not bound
sources.observed: ArrayCAD documents a domain-specific path that reads 3DSOLID data from R2000-R2004 DXF and DWG 2004 and reports that its DWG reader loses most 3DSOLIDs from R2018. Its route notes identify @node-projects/acad-ts, whose README says it is a TypeScript port of ACadSharp. This is an app-reported version-specific loss and a derived route, not an independent parser or general solid qualification result.

sources.revision: Autodesk published DXF reference pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The SOLID entity is corner-based and may carry thickness/extrusion; 3DSOLID uses the AcDbModelerGeometry subclass and proprietary modeler data with an optional history-object link. They must be tracked as distinct feature families.

sources.revision: Mutable master source and issue status reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The reviewed DXF loader source contained no SOLID/3DSOLID entity-name handling, and issue #2645 requests SOLID support. The issue's SOLID request is distinct from ACIS-backed 3DSOLID support, so Assimp is not admitted as a modeler-semantic comparator.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing peer-admission and S8 ACIS evidence gates only. Require exact artifact/source/profile identity, separate carrier retention from parser/topology/mesh/kernel/native outcomes, represent ArrayCAD's ACadSharp-derived path as optional and version-specific, and distinguish DXF SOLID from ACIS-backed 3DSOLID. No implementation queue or validation cadence change.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep per-slice validation on generated local controls; do not add a peer installation, dependency, fixture, CTest, or full-suite requirement from this research.

If ACadRust is selected at a composed checkpoint, bind a release artifact hash to an immutable source commit and verify the exact format version, entity, carrier, read/write direction, and unsupported-record behavior; mark the route NOT_RUN if identity reconciliation is not quick.
Treat ACadRust self-round-trip tests as internal consistency only; use distinct typed/raw oracles and a separate kernel/native route for semantic claims.
If ArrayCAD is selected, pin its application and acad-ts revisions and report DWG R2004 versus R2018 results separately; count the route under ACadSharp-derived lineage.
Distinguish SOLID, 3DFACE, mesh entities, REGION, BODY, SURFACE, and 3DSOLID in feature matrices and test names; a SOLID result cannot promote ACIS/3DSOLID support.
For any ACIS mesh projection, record unsupported entities and curved-face loss; preserve and inspect raw carrier data independently of the typed projection.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL unless their separate external/platform and independent semantic-evidence conditions are met.
